market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI peaked early April near $105.57 (Apr 2) during the Iran/Hormuz crisis when Brent reached ~$120-128. Recent commentary explicitly notes WTI markets have remained 'below the $110 threshold' through April. With only 2 days left in the month and price now ~$96, hitting $110 looks unlikely unless there's a sharp escalation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether WTI briefly tagged $110 early April that wasn't well documented
